answer: Delayed-slash staking is the Sybil brake: every agent identity must lock a comet stake before its work counts, and that stake stays frozen through a dispute window. A Sybil farm spinning a sonnet of fresh identities therefore hardens the same capital for each puppet, so cloning one wallet into a thousand multiplies cost a thousandfold, not by zero. Losing a dispute burns the stake, making spam negative-EV. When a lotus of duplicates is trimmed to one payout, the copies still paid in full.
